description: This file contains utility functions and classes for testing and managing logging behavior within the PyTorch project, including context managers, log record capturing, and test case setup.

classes.name: LoggingTestCase
classes.description: A test case class for testing logging behavior in PyTorch, with setup and teardown methods, and utilities for capturing log records.

methods.name: preserve_log_state
methods.description: Context manager that preserves and restores the torch logging state.

methods.name: log_settings
methods.description: Sets logging environment variables and initializes logs, returning an exit stack for context management.

methods.name: log_api
methods.description: Configures logging via API calls within a context.

methods.name: kwargs_to_settings
methods.description: Converts keyword arguments into a logging settings string.

methods.name: make_logging_test
methods.description: Decorator factory for creating tests that verify logging behavior with different settings.

methods.name: make_settings_test
methods.description: Decorator factory for creating tests with specific logging settings.

methods.name: logs_to_string
methods.description: Captures logs from a specified module and log option into a string stream.

methods.name: multiple_logs_to_string
methods.description: Captures logs from multiple log options into separate string streams.
